stage: Functional metric adaptation of frozen router checkpoints
basis: Eight-coordinate CZ improves teacher-score fit and sparse replay over the old angle circuit, while calibrated MLP and affine Born retain substantially better original-model fidelity. The score/top4 progression criterion is mixed and no architecture is promoted. This separate study tests whether the training geometry, rather than score imitation alone, can improve the deployed expert mixture.
design: Four methods (MLP, affine Born, re-encoded CZ, re-encoded product), three seeds, three losses: coefficient MSE, conditional expert-output Gram, conditional model-output Fisher Gram. 36 fresh adaptations from each method's existing score-fit checkpoint; all three losses start from identical weights and fixed calibration power within each method/seed. Experts, backbone and tokenizer remain frozen.
supervision: Original sparse mixture weights and frozen expert outputs on the same train-only cache. Fisher uses the model's own output distribution, with no next-token labels. All loss variants receive the same train samples and frozen teacher. The Fisher target adds training-time head sensitivity; inference runs only the learned gate and fixed power calibration.
geometry: For delta weights d, coefficient loss d^T d; output loss d^T (V V^T / hidden_dim) d; Fisher loss d^T [0.5 J^T(diag(p)-p p^T)J] d. V comprises centered expert outputs and J the exact LayerNorm/head directional derivatives at the original hidden state. Normalizers are each Gram's mean training trace/16. Finite sparse changes are checked with exact KL separately.
optimization: Fresh AdamW lr0.0003 weight_decay0.0001, clip1, 2000 steps, batch256, same deterministic sample stream. Native top4 selection followed by fixed previously learned calibration power. No straight-through gradient for membership; gradients update selected normalized weights. Checkpoint0 and every200steps compete on the SAME train-only internal-dev exact model-output KL across all losses. Validation is loaded for final reporting after checkpoint selection; test remains reserved.
measurements: Per-seed paired exact CE/KL, sampled PPL, top4/weight errors, output/Fisher loss, route usage, input-only FP16/BF16 roundtrip, saved checkpoint replay, parameter updates, exact samples, immutable sources and original backbones. Compare each adapted model with its own checkpoint0, compare three losses within each architecture, and compare architectures at matched objective. Record initial biases and conditional warm-start scope.
success_interpretation: Consistent internal-dev and reported validation KL reductions for functional losses support functional metric supervision. The CZ-versus-product contrast tests this ansatz's additional reachable directions; the MLP and affine controls assess its practical gap. A quantum design candidate requires useful quality versus these controls together with its measured execution cost. Report all methods, losses and seeds; rare switching events remain descriptive.
budget: Precompute local metrics once perseed, then 36 bounded adaptations. Estimated 30-60 minutes GPU plus audit/report; no expansion based on validation. Stop new launches early enough to preserve the extended stage review around14:45.
prior_artifact_policy: All earlier training, replay v1 failure, corrected v2 and calibration records remain unchanged. This is a new exploratory round; prior validation has already been observed.
